shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'ErrorCodes|SessionListMessage|list_sessions|session_list' src/types/messages.ts src/transport/createServer.ts && cat src/transport/createServer.ts | head -55 && cat src/types/sessionStore.ts | head -55"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'ErrorCodes|SERVER_ERROR' src/types/session.ts; cat src/transport/ws/sender.ts | head -50; cat src/types/messages.ts | head -90"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts'); s=p.read_text(); s += '''\\n/** Wait for a server to observe its clients closing. */\\nexport const eventually = async (check: () => boolean): Promise<void> => {\\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 50 && "'!check(); attempt++) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));'"\\n};\\n\\n/** Forward only the required store operations. */\\nexport const delegatingTo = (inner: SessionStore): SessionStore => ({\\n  create: (sessionId, userId, options) => inner.create(sessionId, userId, options),\\n  get: sessionId => inner.get(sessionId),\\n  delete: sessionId => inner.delete(sessionId),\\n  count: () => inner.count(),\\n  clear: () => inner.clear(),\\n});\\n'''; p.write_text(s)
for name in ['src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts','src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts']:
 p=Path(name); s=p.read_text().replace(\"import {answeringOrchestrator} from './wsTestSupport.js';\", \"import {answeringOrchestrator, delegatingTo, eventually} from './wsTestSupport.js';\")
 start=s.index('const eventually = async '); end=s.index('\\n};',start)+3; s=s[:start]+s[end:]
 start=s.index('const delegatingTo = '); end=s.index('\\n});',start)+4; s=s[:start]+s[end:]; p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('Array(9).fill(false)', '[false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false]'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('    orchestrator: answeringOrchestrator,','    orchestrator: answeringOrchestrator,\\n    history: {enabled: true},'); s=s.replace(\"      if (frame.type === 'connected') {\\n        connected = frame;\\n        client.send(typeof outbound === 'string' ? outbound : JSON.stringify(outbound));\\n        client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1}));\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      if (frame.type === 'pong') {\\n        resolve();\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      frames.push(frame);\", \"      if (frame.type "'!== '"'connected') {\\n        frames.push(frame);\\n        resolve();\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      connected = frame;\\n      client.send(typeof outbound === 'string' ? outbound : JSON.stringify(outbound));\")
s=s.replace('answers an empty session_list when the store has no listFor, and SERVER_ERROR with a ws error log when listFor throws','answers UNSUPPORTED when the store has no listFor, and SERVER_ERROR with a ws error log when listFor throws').replace(\"unimplemented: [{type: 'session_list', sessions: []}],\", \"unimplemented: [{type: 'error', code: 'UNSUPPORTED', message: 'Conversation listing is unsupported'}],\").replace(\"fields: expect.objectContaining({userId: 'u1', error: 'database offline'}),\", \"fields: expect.objectContaining({sessionId: expect.any(String), error: 'database offline'}),\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/types/session.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace(\"  SERVER_ERROR: 'SERVER_ERROR',\", \"  SERVER_ERROR: 'SERVER_ERROR',\\n  UNSUPPORTED: 'UNSUPPORTED',\"); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/transport/createServer.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('  resume?: SessionResumeOptions;', '  resume?: SessionResumeOptions;\\n  history?: {enabled: boolean};').replace('createMessageHandler(options.orchestrator)', 'createMessageHandler(options.orchestrator, options.sessionStore, options.history)'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace(\"import type {SessionEntry} from '../../types/session.js';\", \"import type {SessionEntry} from '../../types/session.js';\\nimport type {SessionStore} from '../../types/sessionStore.js';\\nimport type {ExtWebSocket} from './connectionHandler.js';\"); s=s.replace('export function createMessageHandler(orchestrator: ChatOrchestrator) {','export function createMessageHandler(orchestrator: ChatOrchestrator, store?: SessionStore, history?: {enabled: boolean}) {'); s=s.replace('    // An async action runs up to its first await at once, so a ping is answered now and a throw stays a rejection.', \"    if (validation.valid && validation.data.type === 'list_sessions') {\\n      return answerList(ws as ExtWebSocket, session, validation.data, store, history);\\n    }\\n    // An async action runs up to its first await at once, so a ping is answered now and a throw stays a rejection.\")
pos=s.index('// The whole answer,')
s=s[:pos]+'''async function answerList(\\n  ws: ExtWebSocket,\\n  session: ChatSession,\\n  message: {limit?: number; before?: import('../../types/sessionStore.js').SessionCursor},\\n  store?: SessionStore,\\n  history?: {enabled: boolean}\\n): Promise<void> {\\n  if ("'!history?.enabled || !store?.listFor) {'"\\n    sendError(ws, ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED, 'Conversation listing is unsupported');\\n    return;\\n  }\\n  try {\\n    const rows = await store.listFor(ws.userId, {limit: message.limit, before: message.before});\\n    sendJson(ws, {type: 'session_list', sessions: rows.map(row => ({...row, createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(), updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString()}))});\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    log.error('ws', 'conversation listing failed', {sessionId: session.sessionId, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'});\\n    sendError(ws, ErrorCodes.SERVER_ERROR, 'Failed to list conversations');\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n'''+s[pos:]; p.write_text(s)
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/types/session.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts'

/bin/zsh -lc "git add src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/types/session.ts && git commit -m 'Handle session list requests' && git push origin HEAD"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
